About Me

⚡ Ritesh Kumar Singh

I'm Ritesh Kumar Singh, a B.Tech CSE (Data Science) student at Technocrats Institute of Technology, Bhopal (RGPV Affiliated), graduating August 2029.

My passion lies in how data tells stories. I specialize in building ML models, creating intelligent AI-powered tools, and transforming raw data into actionable insights using Python, Streamlit & NLP.

With 10 live projects, 24 certifications, and multiple competition prizes — I'm constantly pushing the boundaries of what's possible with data and AI.
